episodes.title: The Rebirth of the King
episodes.summary: The most powerful king in the world finds himself in a strange new world... and a helpless infant body.

episodes.title: The King, Under Attack
episodes.summary: Arthur's family decides to move to the city for his education, but the roads prove to be less than safe.

episodes.title: Meeting the King
episodes.summary: Arthur's encounter with some bandits leads to a tumble into a ravine, where he has a bizarre encounter.

episodes.title: Saved by the King
episodes.summary: While trying to make his way home, Arthur encounters a group of bandits who've captured an elf girl.

episodes.title: The King's Test
episodes.summary: Arthur finds himself in hostile territory after escorting Tessia home to the kingdom of elves.

episodes.title: The King's Training
episodes.summary: Virion offers Arthur a means to reach out to his parents, while also offering to take him as an apprentice.

episodes.title: The King Says Goodbye
episodes.summary: Arthur completes his training, and prepares to be reunited with his family.

episodes.title: Reunited with the King
episodes.summary: Arthur is back with his parents, and his new baby sister, Eleanor. Their thoughts to to his future...

episodes.title: The King Teaches
episodes.summary: Arthur worries about Lilia who's dream of attending the magic academy seems in danger due to her lack of mana.

episodes.title: The King's Defiance
episodes.summary: The kingdom's most important VIPs attend the Helstea Auction, and one of them has plans for Sylvie.

episodes.title: The King's Decision
episodes.summary: An encounter with Cynthia, the head of Xyrus Academy, helps Arthur come to a decision.

episodes.title: The King's Departure
episodes.summary: Arthur is escorting by Jasmine to the adventurer's guild, where he will begin his new journey.

episodes.title: The King Begins Adventuring
episodes.summary: Arthur faces one last mission with Jasmine, but the quest unleashes a tragedy no one saw coming.

episodes.title: The Princess Begins Adventuring
episodes.summary: Tessia has a mission to promote harmony between the races as an adventurer, and things aren't going smoothly.

episodes.title: The King Is Stranded
episodes.summary: Arthur, Elijah, and Lucas find themselves on a deserted island, so they try to find a way back home.

episodes.title: The King's Homecoming
episodes.summary: With quests at a standstill due to the recent mana beast issues, Arthur spends some time at home.

episodes.title: The King's Struggles
episodes.summary: Arthur and Jasmine are recruited for a dungeon raid that ends up being more dangerous than it seemed.

episodes.title: The King Is Betrayed
episodes.summary: In the lowest level of the dungeon, Arthur and his party have a horrifying encounter.

episodes.title: The King Survives
episodes.summary: An unexpected ability helps Elijah save Arthur's life, as they try to find a way out of the dungeon.

episodes.title: The King's Gratitude
episodes.summary: Having returned home with Elijah, Arthur prepares for school at the academy and bids Jasmine farewell.

episodes.title: The King Negotiates
episodes.summary: Arthur seeks a gift to give Eleanor for her birthday, and has an interesting encounter as a result.

episodes.title: The King Celebrates
episodes.summary: It's Eleanor's birthday, and Arthur has a special gift for his little sister.

episodes.title: The King Enrolls
episodes.summary: Before enrolling in Xyrus Academy, Arthur faces the person responsible for his disastrous dungeon raid.
